definition: Late check-in, acceptance of passengers after the deadline.
Boarding discrepancies and paging; a checked-in passenger missing at the gate.
Aircraft documentation late or inaccurate; weight and balance (loadsheet).
Fuelling or defuelling, including fuel-supplier delay.
Operational requirements: fuel or load alteration.
Flight deck crew shortage or crew rest requirement.
Weather conditions at the departure station.
De-icing of the aircraft; removal of ice/snow; frost prevention.
Air traffic control restriction en-route or ATC capacity restriction.
Reactionary delay: late arrival of the aircraft from a previous flight.
